exposure: Laparoscopic modified uterine incision pressure repair
cohort: The study included 20 patients diagnosed with type II-III cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP) at the Affiliated Hospital of Guizhou Medical University.
finding: The laparoscopic modified uterine incision pressure repair method was associated with significantly shorter operation time, reduced intraoperative bleeding, and lower hospitalization costs compared to conventional treatment for type II-III CSP.
